content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] ([company_name] [article_no]) to save two analog values, one digital byte, and a timestamp. I know that it is possible to use [product_name] software to download this data, but my customer wants to access it without that software. I followed the [product_name] Access Tool manual and set up a CSV file for reading data. The drawback is that the Excel sheet must remain open and continuously collect data. When configuring the Access Tool, I see a 'historical data' option, but there is no manual guidance on accessing older records. I would be satisfied with getting the last 50 readings, but I'm unclear on how to achieve this. Is it possible to open Excel, start reading, and retrieve the most recent 50-60 records that [product_name] stores on the SD card? Any advice is appreciated.

What you're aiming for isn't supported by the [product_name]. It doesn't offer a time archive, and only current data is accessible through the Access Tool; there are no timestamps. To address your requirements, you would need to use an HMI device (such as a compatible panel). Additionally, direct SD card access via the Access Tool isn't available. You'll need [product_name] software, or remove the SD card and use a PC for access.

Thank you for your reply. In that case, what does 'historical data' mean in the Access Tool? Is purchasing an HMI the only solution? Is there no way to use a script on the web server to transfer data from the SD card to a PC via Ethernet? Otherwise, I may need to consider a different solution than [product_name] for this project.

Can you clarify what you mean by 'What does historical data mean in Access Tool?' Is this stated somewhere? Another option is to use a PC to continuously record the needed data using the Excel Add-In plugin, but then the PC has to run 24/7. The Access Tool can generate a CSV file on the PC. Refer to the Access Tool help documentation. I'm not certain if it's possible to use a script to read the log from the SD card in the [product_name]; I'm not a developer. I also doubt a similar logic module would solve your issue.

Based on my understanding, you can view live data with real-time trends using the [product_name] Access Tool plugin. For recording, the Access Tool creates a logfile.csv with the live data on your PC. To review historical values, you can open the CSV file from your PC and use any database or spreadsheet software for analysis, including graph creation. More details are available in the [product_name] Access Tool Manual PDF.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for ways to access historical data logged on the [product_name] device without needing [product_name] software, specifically aiming to retrieve previous records from the SD card for use in Excel. The device currently does not offer a built-in time-stamped archive or straightforward historical data access via the Access Tool, leading to user frustration over the need for ongoing PC connection to log data. There is uncertainty about the 'historical data' feature in Access Tool and insufficient documentation explaining its actual functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to open Excel and quickly download the most recent historical data (about 50-60 readings) stored on the [product_name]'s SD card, without requiring [product_name] software or constant connection to Excel.
